paper_title: DraftAttention: Fast Video Diffusion via Low-Resolution Attention Guidance
original_abstract: Diffusion transformer–based video generation models (DiTs) have recently attracted widespread attention for their excellent generation quality. However, their computational cost remains a major bottleneck—attention alone accounts for over 80% of total latency, and generating just 8 seconds of 720p video takes tens of minutes—posing serious challenges to practical application and scalability. To address this, we propose the DraftAttention, a training-free framework for the acceleration of video diffusion transformers with dynamic sparse attention on GPUs. We apply down-sampling to each feature map across frames in the compressed latent space, enabling a higher-level receptive field over the latent composed of hundreds of thousands of tokens. The low-resolution draft attention map, derived from draft query and key, exposes redundancy both spatially within each feature map and temporally across frames. We reorder the query, key, and value based on the draft attention map to guide the sparse attention computation in full resolution, and subsequently restore their original order after the attention computation. This reordering enables structured sparsity that aligns with hardware-optimized execution. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that the low-resolution draft attention closely approximates the full attention, providing reliable guidance for constructing accurate sparse attention. Experimental results show that our method outperforms existing sparse attention approaches in video generation quality and achieves up to 1.75×end-to-end speedup on GPUs.

innovative_points.name: Low-Resolution Draft Attention
innovative_points.description: Uses average pooling to create low-resolution draft attention maps that guide sparse computation
innovative_points.technical_details: 8×16 pooling kernel reduces tokens by 128×, creating [n/128, n/128, d] computation
innovative_points.runtime_improvement: [n, n, d] → [n/128, n/128, d] + [n, n, d] with sparsity ratio r

innovative_points.name: Structured Sparsity Pattern
innovative_points.description: Creates region-level sparsity patterns that align with hardware-optimized execution
innovative_points.technical_details: Binary mask M ∈ {0,1}^(g×g) lifted to token resolution M̃ ∈ {0,1}^(n×n)
innovative_points.runtime_improvement: O(n²d) → O(rn²d) where r is sparsity ratio (0.5-0.9)

innovative_points.name: Deterministic Token Reordering
innovative_points.description: Reorders tokens to align region-level sparsity with token-level computation
innovative_points.technical_details: Algorithm 1 groups spatial patches contiguously in memory
innovative_points.runtime_improvement: Enables efficient sparse kernels and coalesced memory access

innovative_points.name: Theoretical Error Bounds
innovative_points.description: Provides formal guarantees on approximation error from draft attention and sparsity
innovative_points.runtime_improvement: Justifies computational savings while maintaining accuracy

innovative_points.name: Training-Free Integration
innovative_points.description: Plug-and-play module requiring no additional training or fine-tuning
innovative_points.technical_details: Works with pre-trained models using off-the-shelf weights

quality_metrics.psnr_improvement: Up to 6.28 dB better than SVG

enhanced.communication: O(n log k) for hierarchical reordering

proposed_improvements.name: Adaptive Kernel Selection
proposed_improvements.description: Dynamically adjust pooling kernel size based on resolution and content complexity
proposed_improvements.technical_approach: Content-aware kernel sizing with motion complexity analysis
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: [n/128, n/128, d] → [n/k, n/k, d] where k adapts to content

proposed_improvements.name: Dynamic Sparsity Scheduling
proposed_improvements.description: Adjust sparsity ratio throughout denoising process based on content and timestep
proposed_improvements.technical_approach: Temporal scheduling with content-adaptive sparsity r(t)
proposed_improvements.expected_improvement: Better quality preservation at high sparsity ratios
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: Fixed r → r(t) ∈ [0.5, 0.95] based on denoising progress

proposed_improvements.name: Multi-Scale Temporal Attention
proposed_improvements.description: Separate spatial and temporal pooling with learnable weights
proposed_improvements.technical_approach: Dual-branch architecture for spatial and temporal drafts
proposed_improvements.expected_improvement: Better handling of fast motion and temporal dynamics
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: Additional [n/64, n/64, d] + [n/256, n/256, d] for multi-scale

proposed_improvements.name: Quantization Integration
proposed_improvements.description: Mixed-precision computation with INT8 draft and FP16 critical paths
proposed_improvements.technical_approach: Adaptive precision based on error bounds
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: Reduced memory bandwidth and faster computation

proposed_improvements.description: Three-level processing for cache efficiency and streaming
